'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Geoff Dearing LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Geoff Dearing]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Geoff Dearing]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|You Can Either Profit By This...]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
